subject: Patterns
source_sentence: Consequently, we generalize beyond specific hashtags to create hashtag patterns that will match all hashtags with the same prefix, such as the pattern #angryat* which will match both #angryattheworld and #angryatlife.
title: Learning Emotion Indicators from Tweets: Hashtags, Hashtag Patterns, and Phrases

subject: Hashtags
source_sentence: Our second observation is that hashtags can also be used to harvest emotion phrases. For example, if we learn that the hashtag #lovelife is associated with JOY, then we can extract the phrase "love life" from the hashtag and use it to recognize emotion in the body of tweets.
title: Learning Emotion Indicators from Tweets: Hashtags, Hashtag Patterns, and Phrases
